pathology-breast-tumor-budding-review-20.title: Tumor budding in breast cancer: current knowledge and clinical perspectives
pathology-breast-tumor-budding-review-20.locator: Breast tumor-budding definitions are heterogeneous; published studies commonly describe isolated cells or small clusters near the invasive margin, often with a maximum of five cells. The editor adopts the stricter executable 1--4-cell mask representation and does not claim a diagnostic score.

pathology-breast-invasive-compartment-st.title: Localization of CD44 and CD90 Positive Cells to the Invasive Front of Breast Tumors
pathology-breast-invasive-compartment-st.locator: The primary breast-tumor study defines tumor-peripheral regions immediately outside morphologically identifiable tumor nests or trabeculae and distinguishes them from central epithelial and intratumoral stromal compartments. The editor uses only the compartment relationship; it does not reproduce the biomarker analysis or ask a visual model to diagnose an invasive front.

pathology-breast-tumor-budding-study-202.title: Joint Tumor Bud-MMP/TIMP Count at the Invasive Front Improves the Prognostic Evaluation of Invasive Breast Carcinoma
pathology-breast-tumor-budding-study-202.locator: The primary study evaluates breast tumor buds as detached groups of one to five malignant cells in tumor stroma. The editor uses a stricter synthetic one-to-four-cell mask variant and makes no diagnostic, grading, biomarker, or prognostic claim.

pathology-breast-collective-invasion-stu.title: Collective invasion in ductal and lobular breast cancer associates with distant metastasis
pathology-breast-collective-invasion-stu.locator: The primary breast-cancer study documents compact multicellular strands, nests and elongated chains in peritumoral fibrous or adipose tissue. It separately identifies very small 2--6-cell clusters, supporting an executable nest that is larger than the tumor-bud-like range without imposing an unsupported universal upper diameter.

pathology-breast-pdc-study-2014.title: Prognostic value of poorly differentiated clusters in invasive breast cancer
pathology-breast-pdc-study-2014.locator: The primary invasive-breast-cancer study defines tumor budding as a single cell or cluster with fewer than five cells and analyzes non-gland-forming cancer clusters with five or more cells. The editor uses a conservative six-cell nest floor to stay clearly beyond the one-to-five-cell bud-like range and makes no diagnostic or prognostic claim.

pathology-breast-microtrack-invasion-stu.title: Cell-cell adhesion and 3D matrix confinement determine jamming transitions in breast cancer invasion
pathology-breast-microtrack-invasion-stu.locator: The primary human breast-carcinoma study documents both thick multilayered IDC strands and thinner multicellular files within stromal microtracks. The executor therefore enlarges cord length and cell count while retaining a narrow, variable caliber instead of converting the edit into a broad sheet.
